prompt: 🚀 Feature Suggestions & Improvements  High-Impact Features  1. Notifications & Integrations  auto-claude -p "add tests" -m 10 --notify slack --slack-webhook https://...  auto-claude -p "refactor" -m 5 --notify discord --discord-webhook https://...  - Notify when PRs are created/merged or loop completes  - Useful for overnight/weekend runs  - Integration with Slack, Discord, email, or webhooks  2. Resume & Checkpointing  auto-claude -p "large refactor" -m 50 --checkpoint-file .auto-claude-state.json  # If crashed or stopped  auto-claude --resume .auto-claude-state.json  - Save state after each iteration (iteration count, cost, notes, last branch)  - Resume from exact point after crashes or manual stops  - Prevents losing progress on long-running tasks  3. Cost Estimation & Analytics  auto-claude -p "add tests" -m 20 --estimate-cost  # Output: Estimated cost: $2.50-$5.00 based on similar iterations  auto-claude -p "refactor" -m 10 --analytics-file usage.json  # Generates detailed analytics: cost per iteration, tokens used, time taken  - Predict costs before running based on similar tasks  - Export detailed analytics (JSON/CSV) for tracking token usage, costs, iteration duration  - Visualize spending over time  4. Smart Scheduling  auto-claude -p "add docs" -m 20 --schedule "weekdays 9pm-6am"  auto-claude -p "refactor" -m 15 --schedule "weekends"  - Run during specific hours (off-hours, nights, weekends)  - Pause during work hours, resume automatically  - Useful for resource management and avoiding conflicts with human developers  5. Multi-Repo Coordination  auto-claude -p "update API schema" --repos "backend,frontend,mobile" -m 10  - Coordinate changes across multiple repositories  - Useful for microservices, monorepos split across repos  - Ensures consistency (e.g., API changes propagate to all clients)  ---  Nice-to-Have Improvements  6. Better Error Recovery  - Smart retry: Automatically retry with different approach after failures  - Error analysis: Have Claude analyze why the previous iteration failed and adjust  - Partial rollback: Rollback specific files if only some changes are problematic  7. Interactive Mode  auto-claude -p "refactor module" -m 10 --interactive  # Prompts user before creating each PR: "Review changes? [Y/n/edit/skip]"  - Pause before each PR for manual review  - Allow editing the PR description or commit message  - Skip iterations if changes look wrong  8. Custom Hooks & Plugins  auto-claude -p "add tests" -m 10 \    --pre-iteration "./scripts/backup.sh" \    --post-pr "./scripts/notify-team.sh" \    --on-error "./scripts/alert.sh"  - Run custom scripts at different lifecycle points  - Enables integration with existing tooling (backups, deployments, notifications)  9. Dependency Graph Awareness  - Automatically detect which files/modules depend on changed code  - Prioritize adding tests to changed dependencies  - Suggest related files that might need updates  10. AI-Powered Code Review  auto-claude -p "refactor" -m 10 --self-review  - Before merging, have Claude review its own PR  - Check for: security issues, breaking changes, test coverage, code quality  - Add review comments as PR comments for transparency  ---  Advanced/Experimental Features  11. Learning & Optimization  - Pattern learning: Analyze successful vs failed iterations to improve prompts  - Codebase indexing: Build a semantic index of your codebase for better context  - Auto-tuning: Automatically adjust prompts based on what works  12.
